prompt: A 2 kg bag of rice costs $8. A 5 kg bag of the same rice costs $17.50. Which bag is better value?

options.text: They are exactly the same value
It is impossible to compare them

explanation: The small bag costs $8 / 2 = $4 per kg. The large bag costs $17.50 / 5 = $3.50 per kg, so the 5 kg bag is better value.
